table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	fullcode=service.aliasname,
	service.servicecode,
	SVCRD.smancode,   
	SVCRD.qty,
	ServiceQty = SVCRD.qty,
	SVCRD.ServicePrice,
	SVCRD.ServiceFlatDisc,
	AllowSaleInDecimal=Service.AllowSaleInDecimal,
	currlistrow = 0,
	SVCRD.servicerinvcode,
	SVCRD.srvrrowid,
	SVCRD.srvrowid,
	retqty = 0,
	SVCRD.commission,
	SVCRD.SharePerc,
	SVCRD.ServiceFlatTax,
	SVCRD.ServiceGstPerc,
	SVCRD.CostPrice,
	SVCRD.discperc
FROM 
	servicerdetail SVCRD,
	service  
WHERE 
	( SVCRD.servicecode = service.servicecode ) and  
	( SVCRD.servicerinvcode = :ra_salesretinvno )

objects.name: c_sumservicevalue
objects.expression: sum((serviceprice - serviceflatdisc) * qty * ( 1 - (discperc *  .01) ) + ( qty * serviceflattax ) + Round(((serviceprice - serviceflatdisc) * qty * ( 1 - (discperc *  .01) ) * servicegstperc * 0.01),2))
